plan_name: Hospital Appointment Booking System - MVP Sprint Plan

tasks.title: Design and implement PostgreSQL database schema with all tables (users, patients, doctors, appointments, doctor_schedules, notifications) including indexes and relationships
Build REST API authentication system with JWT tokens and user registration/login endpoints for Patient, Doctor, and Administrator roles
Develop patient registration and profile management API endpoints with validation for personal and medical information
Create React components for Patient Home Dashboard, Doctor Search, and Appointment Booking screens following the mobile-first design specifications
Implement doctor schedule management API endpoints allowing doctors to set availability and view appointments
Build appointment scheduling API with time slot availability checking, booking creation, and conflict prevention logic
Design and implement My Appointments screen and Notifications Center UI components with status badges and action buttons
Develop appointment cancellation and rescheduling API endpoints with slot release and notification triggers
Implement automated notification system for appointment reminders (24-hour advance) and booking confirmations using background jobs
Create responsive Patient Profile screen with edit functionality and medical history display following accessibility guidelines
Integrate frontend React components with backend REST API endpoints and implement state management for user sessions
Conduct end-to-end testing of patient registration, doctor search, appointment booking, and cancellation workflows on both web and mobile platforms

risks: Time slot conflict management may require complex locking mechanisms to prevent double-booking during concurrent user sessions
Email/SMS notification delivery depends on third-party services which may have integration delays or reliability issues
Mobile responsive design across different device sizes and platforms may require additional testing cycles beyond initial estimates
JWT token security and session management needs careful implementation to prevent unauthorized access to patient medical data
Database performance may degrade with large appointment datasets without proper indexing and query optimization
